title: Object
description: Defines interactive objects in the game world that can be targeted by actions, with specialized interfaces for different interaction types.

name.description: The display name of the object.

object_type.description: The primary type of object this represents.

subtype.description: More specific categorization, e.g., 'Blast Door', 'Computer Terminal', 'Cargo Container'.

era.description: The primary era this object is most associated with, e.g., 'Galactic_Republic', 'Galactic_Empire', 'New_Republic'.

rarity.description: How rare or difficult to obtain this object is.

narrative.description: Rich narrative description of the object's appearance, history, and significance. Used by LLM-GM for storytelling.

flavor_text.description: A memorable quote or description that captures the essence of this object.

description.description: Mechanical description of what this object does and how it functions.

size.description: The size category of the object.

weight.description: The weight of the object, e.g., '50 lbs' or '2 tons'.

durability.description: The object's resistance to damage and wear.

hit_points.description: Total hit points the object can sustain.

damage_threshold.description: Minimum damage required to harm the object.

damage_immunities.description: Damage types this object is immune to.

hackable_interface.description: Properties for objects that can be hacked or sliced.

system_security_level.description: The DC for hacking attempts against this system.

control_on_critical_success.description: Actions that become available on a critical success.

countermeasures_on_failure.description: Negative consequences of failed hacking attempts.

required_tools.description: Tools or equipment needed to attempt hacking.

lockable_interface.description: Properties for objects that can be locked or unlocked.

unlock_requirements.description: What is needed to unlock this object.

alarm_on_failure.description: Whether failed attempts trigger an alarm.

movable_interface.description: Properties for objects that can be moved or manipulated.

strength_requirement.description: Minimum Strength score needed to move this object.

movement_difficulty.description: The DC for moving this object.

movement_speed.description: How fast this object can be moved, e.g., '5 feet per round'.

requires_tools.description: Tools needed to move this object.

examinable_interface.description: Properties for objects that can be examined or investigated.

investigation_dc.description: The DC for investigation checks to learn about this object.

information_tiers.description: Different levels of information available based on investigation results.

special_knowledge.description: Information only available to characters with specific knowledge or skills.

functionality.description: What this object does and how it operates.

primary_function.description: The main purpose or function of this object.

activation_method.description: How this object is activated or used.

power_requirements.description: What powers or energizes this object.

operational_limits.description: Limitations on how this object can be used.

llm_guidance.description: Guidance for LLM-GM on how to use this object in gameplay.

iconic_usage.description: How this object is typically used in Star Wars stories.

tactical_notes.description: Tactical considerations for using this object in encounters.

narrative_hooks.description: Story hooks and plot elements this object can provide.

roleplay_guidance.description: How to describe and roleplay interactions with this object.

properties.$comment: SECTION 8: IMAGE GENERATION (for AI Art Engine)

image_generation.description: Data source for modular AI art generation engine.

base_prompt.description: The foundational prompt for generating images of this object.

contextual_modifiers.description: Modifiers for different image generation contexts.

ui.description: User interface assets and display information.

image.description: Path to the object's representative image.

icon.description: Path to the object's icon for UI elements.

color.description: Primary color associated with this object (hex code).
